localChanges: On the city screen, pressing Enter on a focused button such as Buy or Change now presses that button instead of closing the screen (#484).
Clicking a second specialist before the city has caught up with the first is now ignored until it has, instead of being sent for a citizen who had already changed and quietly lost (#484).
An update to a city while its production list or a confirmation is open over the city screen no longer takes the keyboard away from that window (#484).
Pressing C twice, or Change twice, while the game is busy now opens one production list rather than two, and none at all if you have closed the city screen in the meantime (closes #484).
